request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, fur and feather texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, collars, signs, books, balls and dishes. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows a person from behind on a park bench by a lake. Keep exactly the same person, long beige coat, grey knitted hat, dark scarf, bench, park and camera position. Create a new photograph that adds the person's pet: a medium-size golden-tan mixed-breed dog with a white chest patch, floppy ears and a plain red collar SITS on the ground close beside the bench, also seen from behind, looking at the lake, on a short red leash that the person holds in one gloved hand. The person is still seen only from behind, so it is impossible to tell whether it is a man or a woman. The person, the bench and the whole dog are sharp and inside the central 65 percent of the photo width. Exactly one person and one dog; nobody else and no other animal.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
